hero.title: Stuck on I-40? We're 22 Minutes Away.

services.title: Emergency Towing
services.shortDesc: Light, medium & heavy-duty towing across Amarillo and the Panhandle.
services.longDesc: Whether you're stuck on the side of I-40 or stranded in a parking lot, our certified operators arrive fast with the right equipment. Flatbed and wheel-lift options keep your vehicle damage-free during transport.

faq.q: Can I ride in the tow truck?
faq.a: Yes, up to two passengers can ride in the cab. Inform dispatch when calling.
Yes — we always use a flatbed for AWD/4x4 to prevent drivetrain damage.
Average dispatch time is 22–28 minutes inside city limits.

services.title: Flat Tire Repair
services.shortDesc: Fast tire change, plug, or patch service anywhere on the highway.
services.longDesc: Blown a tire on I-40? We bring the tools, the spare changeover gear, and the experience to get you rolling again — passenger cars, light trucks, and commercial rigs.

faq.q: Do you bring a new tire?
faq.a: We change to your spare. If you don't have one, we can tow you to the nearest tire shop.

faq.q: Can you patch on the spot?
faq.a: Yes for plug-able punctures. Sidewall damage requires replacement.

services.title: Battery Jump Start
services.shortDesc: High-amperage boost for cars, trucks, and diesel rigs.
services.longDesc: Dead battery? Our heavy-duty jump packs get you started fast. We also test the battery and alternator on-site so you know whether it's just a weak battery or a charging system issue.

faq.a: We test the battery and alternator. If replacement is needed we offer it on-site.

services.title: Vehicle Lockout
services.shortDesc: Damage-free lockout service for cars, trucks & smart keys.
services.longDesc: Locked your keys in the car? Our trained operators use professional lockout tools that won't damage your weather stripping, paint, or window. We service standard locks, key-fob systems, and push-start vehicles.

faq.a: No. We use professional non-marring tools designed for modern vehicles.

services.title: Fuel Delivery
services.shortDesc: Out of gas? We bring it to you across the Panhandle.
services.longDesc: Ran out of fuel on the highway? We deliver gasoline or diesel to your location 24/7. No need to leave your vehicle on the shoulder.

faq.a: Both. Just tell dispatch which you need.

services.title: Winch-Out & Recovery
services.shortDesc: Stuck in mud, snow, or a ditch? We pull you out.
services.longDesc: From light recoveries to heavy-duty rotator work, we handle vehicles stuck off-road, in mud, snow drifts, ditches, or in jackknife situations on the highway.

faq.a: Yes — our heavy-duty rotator handles rollover and jackknife recovery on I-40.

services.title: Mobile Mechanic
services.shortDesc: On-site diagnostics & repairs for cars, trucks & diesels.
services.longDesc: Avoid the tow when you can. Our mobile mechanics handle alternators, starters, brakes, belts, hoses, electrical, DEF/DPF issues, and more — wherever you broke down.

faq.a: Most electrical, brake, belt, hose, and starter/alternator jobs. Major engine work needs a shop.

services.title: Semi Truck Repair
services.shortDesc: I-40 mobile diesel repair, air brakes, DPF & DOT.
services.longDesc: Specialized in heavy-duty road service for OTR trucks broken down anywhere on I-40, I-27, US-87, US-287, and US-60. Air brake repair, DPF/DEF, electrical, tires, and DOT inspection support.

faq.q: Do you offer NET-30 fleet billing?
faq.a: Yes — see our Fleet section. Approved fleets get priority dispatch.
Yes — we can perform mobile DOT inspections and minor repairs to keep you compliant.

about.title: Texas Panhandle's First Responders for Stranded Drivers
about.p1: Maxwell Roadside has been serving Amarillo and the I-40 corridor for over a decade. Our crews are AAA certified, DOT licensed, and fully insured. We treat every breakdown like an emergency — because to you, it is.
about.p2: From single-mom flat tires in the school pickup line to jackknifed semis on the interstate, our team handles every call with professionalism, fair pricing, and the gear to get you rolling again.

fleet.title: Fleet & Commercial Accounts
fleet.subtitle: NET-30 Billing • Priority Dispatch • Insurance Direct-Bill
fleet.body: Trucking companies, regional fleets, and insurance partners across the Texas Panhandle rely on Maxwell Roadside for 24/7 commercial response. We offer dedicated dispatch lines, NET-30 invoicing, direct billing to your insurance carrier, and DOT-compliant heavy-duty equipment including 75-ton rotator service.

pages.title: Our Story
pages.metaDescription: Learn how Maxwell Roadside became the Texas Panhandle's most trusted 24/7 emergency dispatch service.

blocks.content: Maxwell Roadside started with a single tow truck and a promise: when someone is stranded, the response has to be fast, fair, and honest.

Today, our crews cover the entire Texas Panhandle — from I-40 west to Tucumcari and east to Shamrock, plus the I-27 corridor south to Canyon. We're AAA certified, DOT licensed, fully insured, and proudly bilingual.

blocks.caption: Our heavy-duty fleet ready for dispatch

blocks.content: Transparent pricing. No bait-and-switch. The number we quote on the phone is the number you pay when we arrive.

pages.title: Transparent Pricing
pages.metaDescription: Honest, flat-rate pricing for towing, jump starts, lockouts, fuel delivery, and winch-out service in Amarillo, TX.

blocks.content: No hidden fees. No surprise charges. The price we quote is the price you pay.

Light-Duty Tow: $95 hookup + $4/mile after 10 mi
Medium-Duty Tow: $125 hookup + $5/mile after 10 mi
Jump Start: $65 flat
Lockout: $75 flat
Fuel Delivery: $85 + fuel cost
Winch-Out: from $125 (varies by difficulty)
* Heavy-duty / commercial / semi-truck pricing is by-quote. Call dispatch for an exact rate.

pages.title: Service Area
pages.metaDescription: Maxwell Roadside covers Amarillo, the entire I-40 corridor, I-27, and a 100-mile radius across the Texas Panhandle.

blocks.content: Our service area covers a 100-mile radius from Amarillo, including the entire I-40 corridor from Tucumcari NM to Shamrock TX, the I-27 corridor south to Canyon, and US-87/US-287/US-60 across the Panhandle.
